task: Add a narrowly scoped ChatGPT Ops production operation named octopus-qdrant-healthcheck-repair. Context: Octopus v1.0.122 is installed at /opt/octopus on ed-finder-prod. qdrant/qdrant:v1.17.0 is actually ready (host GET http://127.0.0.1:43333/readyz returns 'all shards are ready') but Docker marks octopus-qdrant-1 unhealthy because docker-compose.selfhost.yml uses a healthcheck invoking wget, and the Qdrant image contains neither wget nor curl. The Octopus web container is created but blocked by depends_on qdrant healthy. Implement this through the existing fail-closed ChatGPT Ops control plane, NOT by accessing production. Requirements: (1) add octopus-qdrant-healthcheck-repair to .github/workflows/chatgpt-ops.yml allowlist and route it to a dedicated operator stage; (2) add a purpose-built scripts/operator/actions/octopus-qdrant-healthcheck-repair.sh and wire it in scripts/operator/actions/dispatch.sh; (3) script must verify expected host/deployment context where practical, require /opt/octopus/docker-compose.selfhost.yml, verify the exact broken wget Qdrant healthcheck exists before editing, refuse if it does not match, back up the compose file, replace only that Qdrant healthcheck with a dependency-free in-container readiness check suitable for qdrant:v1.17.0 (for example checking port 6333 via /proc/net/tcp and /proc/net/tcp6), validate docker compose config, force-recreate only qdrant, wait bounded time for Docker health=healthy, independently verify host /readyz returns success, then start web and verify 127.0.0.1:43300 plus /api/health and /api/version. Do not print secrets or admin password. Do not touch PostgreSQL data, volumes, migrations, model rows, or .env values. Fail closed on any unexpected state. Emit a concise machine-readable receipt/result. (4) add focused tests covering the allowlist/dispatcher and script safety guards where feasible. Read CLAUDE.md and existing operator/control-plane patterns first. Do not deploy or access production; only implement and test the repository changes so ChatGPT can execute the new operation afterward via the existing Hetzner operator workflow.
